_about: Maps. Walk off an edge listed in `exits` to travel to that map. `theme` picks ground tiles, ponds, fairy rings and scenery (art ids from art/assets.json); props with `cluster` grow in groups, `sway` ones move in the breeze. `ambience` adds particles (petals | leaves | fireflies | sparkles | bubbles | dandelions | sprinkles | lanterns | zzz | notes, joined with +), butterflies, `critters` that hop off when you come near (bunny | frog | crab), `birds` crossing the sky (songbirds | gulls | bats), cloud shadows, a colour tint and `weather` weights (clear | cloudy | rain | storm | fog | snow; {} for no sky). A prop with `bob` floats gently up and down. Maps with `encounters` have random battles; `music` is a song id from music.json. Building/decor/NPC x,y are tile offsets from the map centre (y up). Boss NPCs name their `monster` and `level`, `minions` (how many of the map's own monsters fight beside it, 9 unless set), `waves` (how many waves the fight comes in, 3 unless set: waves of 10 of the map's monsters, then the boss) and a `victory` story (a title and 1 to 3 short paragraphs), told the first time you beat it.

villagerLines: Mind the jellies past the gate.
The fountain sparkles at night, you know.
Have you visited the guilds yet?

npcs.name: Nurse Mira
npcs.greeting: Tired, dear? Rest here and your whole party will feel brand new.

npcs.name: Trader Bo
npcs.greeting: Potions, blades, robes — take a look!

npcs.name: Elder Oak
npcs.greeting: Ah, a new face! Meadowbrook could use a helping hand.

npcs.name: Captain Brann
npcs.greeting: The Warrior Guild wants strong arms and brave hearts.

npcs.name: Sage Lumi
npcs.greeting: The Arcane Circle studies the seven elements. Magic is a path of patience.

npcs.name: Ranger Pip
npcs.greeting: The Wildfolk Lodge! We befriend beasts, not beat them. Well, mostly.

npcs.name: Smith Tobin
npcs.greeting: Clang! Bring me wood and metal from the wilds and I'll forge you something fine.

npcs.name: Mother Sheep
npcs.greeting: Baa! Oh, a kind face at last.

npcs.name: Old Shelly
npcs.greeting: Click-clack! Mind the tide pools, youngster.

npcs.name: Willow the Wisp
npcs.greeting: Shh... the woods are listening.

npcs.name: Little Pig
npcs.greeting: Oink! Have you seen a wolf around here?

npcs.name: Grumpy Old Oak
npcs.greeting: Hrmph. Stop smiling at me. STOP IT.

victory.title: The Forest Smiles Again
story: The Grumpy Old Oak creaks, sags, and lets out a sigh a thousand years long. Then, slowly, the corners of its bark curl up.
It will never admit it, but it rather likes the Wood Monkeys swinging in its branches. The Smiling Forest lives up to its name again.

villagerLines: The fountain sparkles at night, you know.

npcs.name: Healer Lily
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Prismhaven! Rest a while, adventurer.

npcs.name: Prismhaven Market
npcs.greeting: The finest goods this side of the rainbow!

npcs.name: Mayor Poppy
npcs.greeting: Oh! You came all the way through the Smiling Forest? Splendid!

npcs.name: Smith Iris
npcs.greeting: Monsters drop the best materials. Bring them here and we'll make something sharp.

npcs.name: Tilly the Toymaker
npcs.greeting: Oh, hello! I make a toy of every monster I've seen a card of. Found any cards on your travels?

npcs.name: Big Bad Wolf
npcs.greeting: Grrr… what big eyes you have. All the better to FIGHT you with!

victory.title: Nobody's Afraid Anymore
story: The Big Bad Wolf huffs, puffs and runs off into the snow with its tail between its legs. It won't be blowing any houses down.
Red hoods can walk Snow White Forest without looking over their shoulders. Mayor Poppy will want to hear, and Prismhaven is buzzing with news from Moonwhisper.

npcs.name: Mister Frost
npcs.greeting: Brrr-illiant to see you!

npcs.name: Frog Prince
npcs.greeting: Ribbit. I am a prince, you know. Truly.

npcs.name: Ugly Duckling
npcs.greeting: Oh... hello. You don't think I'm ugly, do you?

npcs.name: Brave Mouse
npcs.greeting: Squeak! Small, but brave!

npcs.name: Great Wisp
npcs.greeting: Ooooh, follow the pretty light... just a little further... hee hee!

victory.title: The Light Goes Out
story: The Great Wisp flickers, giggles one last time and goes out like a candle. All over the valley, the little lights fade with it.
Travellers can keep to the road again; Shiverdell is only a dark valley now. Only the cavern to the east still squeaks.

npcs.name: Rat King
npcs.greeting: Squeak! Who dares enter MY cavern? Bow to the king!

victory.title: The Rat King Falls
story: The Rat King's crown rolls across the cavern floor and spins to a stop. The rats look at it, look at each other, and scatter.
With no king in the way, the dwarves of Ingothold aren't cut off anymore. Tell Elder Oak: the road south through Shiverdell can open at last.

npcs.name: Healer Brunhild
npcs.greeting: Hammer-bruised? Sit down, I'll patch you up.

npcs.name: Dwarven Forge
npcs.greeting: Forged in Ingothold, built to last a thousand years!

npcs.name: Chief Brom
npcs.greeting: You cleared the cavern? Then Ingothold owes you one, friend.

npcs.name: Smith Ingot
npcs.greeting: Ingothold steel is the finest there is. Show me what you've gathered.

npcs.name: Drunk Dragon
npcs.greeting: *hic* Heyyy… you wanna piece of this? *hic*

victory.title: A Dragon Sobers Up
story: The Drunk Dragon hiccups out one last puff of smoke, lies down by the oasis and starts to snore. It's going to wake up with a terrible headache.
The caravans can come back to the oasis, and Ingothold's trade with them. Chief Brom will want to hear, and with the desert safe, the roads out of Ingothold can open.

npcs.name: Puss in Boots
npcs.greeting: Good day! A fine pair of boots you have.

npcs.name: Pebble
npcs.greeting: ...rumble. Oh! Sorry, I was napping.

npcs.name: Stardust
npcs.greeting: Neigh... the stars are restless tonight.

npcs.name: Moon Rabbit Queen
npcs.greeting: Who stole my moon-mochi? Was it YOU? Hop to it and face me!

victory.title: The Queen Hops Home
story: The Moon Rabbit Queen sits down with a bump, ears drooping. Then a small rabbit peeks out from behind the throne, cheeks full, whiskers dusted with mochi.
Mystery solved. The queen scoops up the little thief and hops back up to the moon, and Moonwhisper can sleep under a quiet full moon again.

npcs.name: Gilded Brute
npcs.greeting: The Gilded King's treasure is mine! Mine, mine, MINE!

victory.title: Fool's Gold
story: The Brute topples back into its hoard, and the hoard goes clink. Pebbles. Painted gold, every last one.
If the Gilded King was ever here, it left long ago. With no one to shout at them, the Golden Slimes go back to bouncing, and Elder Oak will have a good laugh.

npcs.name: Howlmaster
npcs.greeting: Grrr... the sheep's lambs are ours. Turn back, little hero.

victory.title: The Lambs Come Home
story: The Howlmaster limps off into the dark, and the pack slinks after it. Behind a rock, something small says baa.
Mother Sheep's lambs are free, and they know the way home over Gumdrop Peaks. Nella the Tailor will be glad: no wool is finer than a happy lamb's.

villagerLines: The fountain sparkles at night, you know.

npcs.name: Healer Mei
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Larkspur. Let me see those scrapes.

npcs.name: Larkspur Market
npcs.greeting: Cloth, potions and charms, fresh from the capital!

npcs.name: Nella the Tailor
npcs.greeting: Mind the thread! Larkspur's finest tailor, at your service.

npcs.name: Old Swan Keeper
npcs.greeting: The swans come home in spring. Every one of them was once an ugly duckling.

npcs.name: Thumbelina
npcs.greeting: Oh! Hello, giant. Please mind the lily pads, one of them is my house.

npcs.name: Hermit Orrin
npcs.greeting: The puppets on the hill used to dance for children. Now they don't stop.

npcs.name: Marionette King
npcs.greeting: Dance! Dance for your king, forever and ever!

victory.title: The Strings Are Cut
story: The Marionette King's strings go slack. All over the hill the puppets stop mid-step and sit down, as if someone finally told them they could rest.
Hermit Orrin says they used to dance for children. Maybe one day they will again, but only when they want to. The animals can come home to Marionette Rise.

npcs.name: Ambrose the Wise
npcs.greeting: The goddess Liora hid her treasure where only the patient look.

npcs.name: Jory
npcs.greeting: Rosalind fell asleep a year ago and never woke up. The whole town did.

npcs.name: Craghulk
npcs.greeting: Rrrrmmmbbllle... sleep... everyone... sleep...

victory.title: Dozywick Wakes Up
story: The Craghulk crumbles into a heap of quiet stones. The snoring that filled the cave for a whole year stops.
In town, someone yawns, then someone else. For the first time in a year, Rosalind's eyes open, and Jory has a whole year of news to tell.

npcs.name: Morvane
npcs.greeting: The goddess's treasure has a guardian, and it is me.

victory.title: The Goddess's Treasure
story: Morvane sinks to one knee. “Then guard it well,” it rumbles, and fades into the grass like a shadow at noon.
Where it stood, Dreamstone glows in the earth, bright as a golem's heart. Ambrose the Wise will want to hear, but the ore's trail runs on, south to Sneezle Isle.

npcs.name: Temple Keeper
npcs.greeting: The Tidewater Shrine sank beneath the lake long ago. Something still guards it.

npcs.name: Wavecrest Dragon
npcs.greeting: The lake keeps its secrets. So will your bones.

victory.title: The Tide Turns
story: The Wavecrest Dragon sinks into the deepest pool of the temple, and the water goes still for the first time in an age.
The Tidewater Shrine still keeps its secrets, but no longer with teeth. The Temple Keeper can walk its halls again, and boats can cross Briarmere without fear.

npcs.name: Silverfang Warden
npcs.greeting: The Silver Wraith sends his regards.

victory.title: The Way Is Open
story: The Warden's silver armour clatters to the cave floor, empty. Whatever was inside has fled, back to the master it served.
Travellers can pass through the Whispering Hollow to the Emerald Road again. The Emerald Guard will want to hear. And somewhere far away, the Silver Wraith knows your name.

npcs.name: Emerald Guard
npcs.greeting: Follow the road to the Emerald City. Nobody said it was safe.

npcs.name: Emerald Dragon
npcs.greeting: At the end of the road, a dragon. Of course there is.

victory.title: The Emerald Gates
story: The Emerald Dragon lowers its great head and steps aside. Behind it, the gates of the Emerald City shine green in the evening light.
From a wooden sword in Meadowbrook to the gates of the Emerald City, you've walked the longest road in Storyleaf. The Emerald Guard will hardly believe it.
